Title: New Azure for Operators products and partner programs released

Body.Content:
With Azure for Operators, Microsoft is empowering telecom operators to modernize and monetize their 5G investments, enabling enterprises with ubiquitous computing that spans from cloud to edge, and helping developers and ISVs to build more innovative, network-aware applications. At Mobile World Congress 2023 (2/27-3/2), the world’s most influential event for the connectivity industry, Azure for Operators is announcing our next wave of services and programs.

Telecom operators’ offerings:

  • Azure Operator Nexus (public preview) and Azure Operator Nexus Ready & SI programs
  • Azure Operator Insights (public preview)
  • Azure Operator Service Manager (public preview)
  • Azure Communications Gateway (GA)
  • Azure Operator Voicemail (private preview)

Enterprises and developers’ offerings:

  • Azure Private 5G Core (GA)
  • Azure Edge Network Fabric (private preview)
  • Azure private and public MEC ISV programs
  • Azure public MEC with AT&T (GA Detroit, coming soon in Los Angeles, Miami, and New York
  • Azure public MEC with Singtel (private preview)
  • Azure Programmable Connectivity (private preview)

 

  • Read the announcement blog to learn more.
  • Get update field facing content at GearUp: Azure for Operators (microsoft.com)
